title: Three Weeks and One Short Cable
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：link　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 link 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1996 the engineer ① built the link that no user in the network would have recorded, and he said the building was the whole of the week. The ② link, meaning the connection itself and not the cable, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a link, he said, is the only thing in a network that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ link in that network had the same short cable beside it, and the ④ link at the far node, meaning the path they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A link, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the link was the whole of the matter, meaning the bridge and not the connection. The ⑥ link, meaning the bridge and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; link, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a connection and a bridge. He said the bridge is the part they remember.

By 2001 the ⑦ link had become a line in a diagram, and the diagram had become an argument about the short cable. The ⑧ link of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in June, was one network and three weeks of recording; link, he said, is either the path at the far node or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ link I remember is the connection recorded in the diagram, which closed in 2003 and is still recorded as the quietest in the network. A ⑩ link, my mother said in 2005, is the only connection that improves by being recorded; every link, she said, is a bridge that has agreed to look like a connection. She said the bridge was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 连接；链接（指网络里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 连接；链接（指那条连接本身，与线缆相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the link 搭建这条连接
D. n. 连接；链接（指留给孩子们顺着走的那条路那一条）
E. n. 组网之事（抽象总称，指一处网络的连接之事）
F. n. 连接；链接（指线路图里写到、被记载的的那一条）
G. n. 桥接、纽带（指一件事里人人都连却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 纽带（抽象总称，指人人都连却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the link that no user in the network would have recorded
The link, meaning the connection itself and not the cable
the link at the far node

answers.why: build the link 意为“搭建这条连接”，1996 年那位工程师把网络里没有一位用户肯记载的一条连接做了一遍。
link 意为“连接；链接”，指那条连接本身而不是线缆，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
link 意为“连接；链接”，指网络里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一根细细的线缆。
link 意为“连接；链接”，指最远那个节点留给孩子们顺着走的那条路那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
link 意为“桥接、纽带”，指一件事里人人都连却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条纽带就是那件事的全部。
link 意为“纽带”，指人人都连却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条连接，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
link 意为“连接；链接”，指线路图里写到、被记载的的那一条，到 2001 年这一条成了线路图里的一行。
link 意为“组网之事”，工程师六月写道，整件事的连接之事是一处网络和三个星期的记载。
link 意为“连接；链接”，我记得的是线路图里记载过的那一条，2003 年接通了，至今仍被说成网络里最安静的一条。
link 为抽象总称，母亲 2005 年说，连接是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的连接。
